verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בֹּרַאֲךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹצֶרְךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַל־ תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י גְאַלְתִּ֔יךָ קָרָ֥אתִי בְשִׁמְךָ֖ לִי־ אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh bō·ra·’ă·ḵā ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yō·ṣer·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’al- tî·rā kî ḡə·’al·tî·ḵā qā·rā·ṯî ḇə·šim·ḵā lî- ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: But now this is what the LORD says He who created you O Jacob and He who formed you O Israel Do not fear for I have redeemed you I have called you by your name you are Mine
verses.literalPt: MAS agora, assim diz o SENHOR que te criou, ó Jacó, e que te formou, ó Israel: Não temas, porque eu te remi; chamei-te pelo teu nome, tu és meu.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תַעֲבֹ֤ר בַּמַּ֙יִם֙ אִתְּךָ־ אָ֔נִי וּבַנְּהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּךָ כִּֽי־ תֵלֵ֤ךְ בְּמוֹ־ אֵשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶ֔ה וְלֶהָבָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִבְעַר־ בָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯa·‘ă·ḇōr bam·ma·yim ’it·tə·ḵā- ’ā·nî ū·ḇan·nə·hā·rō·wṯ lō yiš·ṭə·p̄ū·ḵā kî- ṯê·lêḵ bə·mōw- ’êš lō ṯik·kā·weh wə·le·hā·ḇāh lō ṯiḇ·‘ar- bāḵ
verses.literal: When you pass through the waters I will be with you and when you go through the rivers they will not overwhelm you When you walk through the fire you will not be scorched the flames will not set you ablaze . . .
verses.literalPt: Quando passares pelas águas estarei contigo, e quando pelos rios, eles não te submergirão; quando passares pelo fogo, não te queimarás, nem a chama arderá em ti.

verses.original: כִּ֗י אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִׁיעֶ֑ךָ נָתַ֤תִּי כָפְרְךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם כּ֥וּשׁ וּסְבָ֖א תַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl mō·wō·šî·‘e·ḵā nā·ṯat·tî ḵā·p̄ə·rə·ḵā miṣ·ra·yim kūš ū·sə·ḇā taḥ·te·ḵā
verses.literal: For I am the LORD your God the Holy One of Israel your Savior I give Egypt for your ransom Cush and Seba in your place
verses.literalPt: Porque eu sou o SENHOR teu Deus, o Santo de Israel, o teu Salvador; dei o Egito por teu resgate, a Etiópia e a Seba em teu lugar.

verses.original: מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָקַ֧רְתָּ בְעֵינַ֛י נִכְבַּ֖דְתָּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֲהַבְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֶתֵּ֤ן אָדָם֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יךָ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’ă·šer yā·qar·tā ḇə·‘ê·nay niḵ·baḏ·tā wa·’ă·nî ’ă·haḇ·tî·ḵā wə·’et·tên ’ā·ḏām taḥ·te·ḵā ū·lə·’um·mîm ta·ḥaṯ nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Because you are precious and honored in My sight and because I love you I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life
verses.literalPt: Visto que foste precioso aos meus olhos, também foste honrado, e eu te amei, assim dei os homens por ti, e os povos pela tua vida.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּירָ֖א כִּ֣י אִתְּךָ־ אָ֑נִי מִמִּזְרָח֙ אָבִ֣יא זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֖ב אֲקַבְּצֶֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tî·rā kî ’it·tə·ḵā- ’ā·nî mim·miz·rāḥ ’ā·ḇî zar·‘e·ḵā ū·mim·ma·‘ă·rāḇ ’ă·qab·bə·ṣe·kā
verses.literal: Do not be afraid for I am with you I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west
verses.literalPt: Não temas, pois, porque estou contigo; trarei a tua descendência desde o oriente, e te ajuntarei desde o ocidente.

verses.original: אֹמַ֤ר לַצָּפוֹן֙ תֵּ֔נִי וּלְתֵימָ֖ן אַל־ תִּכְלָ֑אִי הָבִ֤יאִי בָנַי֙ מֵרָח֔וֹק וּבְנוֹתַ֖י מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·mar laṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn tê·nî ū·lə·ṯê·mān ’al- tiḵ·lā·’î hā·ḇî·’î ḇā·nay mê·rā·ḥō·wq ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯay miq·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I will say to the north Give them up and to the south Do not hold them back Bring My sons from afar and My daughters from the ends of the earth
verses.literalPt: Direi ao norte: Dá; e ao sul: Não retenhas; trazei meus filhos de longe e minhas filhas das extremidades da terra.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל הַנִּקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֔י וְלִכְבוֹדִ֖י בְּרָאתִ֑יו יְצַרְתִּ֖יו אַף־ עֲשִׂיתִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kōl han·niq·rā ḇiš·mî wə·liḵ·ḇō·w·ḏî bə·rā·ṯîw yə·ṣar·tîw ’ap̄- ‘ă·śî·ṯîw
verses.literal: everyone called by My name and created for My glory whom I have indeed formed . . . and made
verses.literalPt: A todos os que são chamados pelo meu nome e os que criei para a minha glória, os formei, e também os fiz.

verses.original: הוֹצִ֥יא עַם־ עִוֵּ֖ר וְעֵינַ֣יִם יֵ֑שׁ וְחֵרְשִׁ֖ים וְאָזְנַ֥יִם לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·ṣî ‘am- ‘iw·wêr wə·‘ê·na·yim yêš wə·ḥê·rə·šîm wə·’ā·zə·na·yim lā·mōw
verses.literal: Bring out a people who have eyes but are blind and who have ears but are deaf
verses.literalPt: Trazei o povo cego, que tem olhos; e os surdos, que têm ouvidos.

verses.original: כָּֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֞ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֗ו וְיֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִ֤י בָהֶם֙ יַגִּ֣יד זֹ֔את וְרִֽאשֹׁנ֖וֹת יַשְׁמִיעֻ֑נוּ יִתְּנ֤וּ עֵֽדֵיהֶם֙ וְיִצְדָּ֔קוּ וְיִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- hag·gō·w·yim niq·bə·ṣū yaḥ·dāw wə·yê·’ā·sə·p̄ū lə·’um·mîm mî ḇā·hem yag·gîḏ zōṯ wə·ri·šō·nō·wṯ yaš·mî·‘u·nū yit·tə·nū ‘ê·ḏê·hem wə·yiṣ·dā·qū wə·yiš·mə·‘ū wə·yō·mə·rū ’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble Who among them can declare this and proclaim to us the former things Let them present their witnesses to vindicate them so that others may hear and say It is true
verses.literalPt: Todas as nações se congreguem, e os povos se reúnam; quem dentre eles pode anunciar isto, e fazer-nos ouvir as coisas antigas? Apresentem as suas testemunhas, para que se justifiquem, e se ouça, e se diga: Verdade é.

verses.original: אַתֶּ֤ם עֵדַי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְעַבְדִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתִּי לְמַ֣עַן תֵּ֠דְעוּ וְתַאֲמִ֨ינוּ לִ֤י וְתָבִ֙ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא לְפָנַי֙ לֹא־ נ֣וֹצַר אֵ֔ל וְאַחֲרַ֖י לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’at·tem ‘ê·ḏay nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·‘aḇ·dî ’ă·šer bā·ḥā·rə·tî lə·ma·‘an tê·ḏə·‘ū wə·ṯa·’ă·mî·nū lî wə·ṯā·ḇî·nū kî- ’ă·nî hū lə·p̄ā·nay lō- nō·w·ṣar ’êl wə·’a·ḥă·ray lō yih·yeh
verses.literal: You are My witnesses declares the LORD and My servant whom I have chosen so that you may consider and believe Me and understand that I am He Before Me no god was formed and after Me none will come
verses.literalPt: Vós sois as minhas testemunhas, diz o SENHOR, e meu servo, a quem escolhi; para que o saibais, e me creiais, e entendais que eu sou o mesmo, e que antes de mim deus nenhum se formou, e depois de mim nenhum haverá.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מִבַּלְעָדַ֖י מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·nō·ḵî Yah·weh wə·’ên mib·bal·‘ā·ḏay mō·wō·šî·a‘
verses.literal: I yes I am the LORD and there is no Savior but Me
verses.literalPt: Eu, eu sou o SENHOR, e fora de mim não há Salvador.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֞י הִגַּ֤דְתִּי וְהוֹשַׁ֙עְתִּי֙ וְהִשְׁמַ֔עְתִּי וְאֵ֥ין בָּכֶ֖ם זָ֑ר וְאַתֶּ֥ם עֵדַ֛י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה וַֽאֲנִי־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî hig·gaḏ·tî wə·hō·wō·ša‘·tî wə·hiš·ma‘·tî wə·’ên bā·ḵem zār wə·’at·tem ‘ê·ḏay nə·’um- Yah·weh wa·’ă·nî- ’êl
verses.literal: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed I, and not some foreign god among you So you are My witnesses declares the LORD that I am God
verses.literalPt: Eu anunciei, e eu salvei, e eu o fiz ouvir, e deus estranho não houve entre vós, pois vós sois as minhas testemunhas, diz o SENHOR; eu sou Deus.

verses.original: גַּם־ מִיּוֹם֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּ֑יל אֶפְעַ֖ל וּמִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃ס
verses.transliteration: gam- mî·yō·wm ’ă·nî hū wə·’ên mî·yā·ḏî maṣ·ṣîl ’ep̄·‘al ū·mî yə·šî·ḇen·nāh
verses.literal: Even from eternity I am He and none can deliver out of My hand When I act who can reverse it
verses.literalPt: Ainda antes que houvesse dia, eu sou; e ninguém há que possa fazer escapar das minhas mãos; agindo eu, quem o impedirá?

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְכֶ֖ם קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְמַעַנְכֶ֞ם שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי בָבֶ֗לָה וְהוֹרַדְתִּ֤י בָֽרִיחִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם וְכַשְׂדִּ֖ים בָּאֳנִיּ֥וֹת רִנָּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh gō·’al·ḵem qə·ḏō·wōš yiś·rā·’êl lə·ma·‘an·ḵem šil·laḥ·tî ḇā·ḇe·lāh wə·hō·w·raḏ·tî ḇā·rî·ḥîm kul·lām wə·ḵaś·dîm bā·’o·nî·yō·wṯ rin·nā·ṯām
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer the Holy One of Israel For your sake I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives even the Chaldeans in the ships in which they rejoice
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR, vosso Redentor, o Santo de Israel: Por amor de vós enviei a Babilônia, e a todos fiz descer como fugitivos, os caldeus, nos navios com que se vangloriavam.

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קְדֽוֹשְׁכֶ֑ם בּוֹרֵ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מַלְכְּכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh qə·ḏō·wō·šə·ḵem bō·w·rê yiś·rā·’êl mal·kə·ḵem
verses.literal: I am the LORD your Holy One the Creator of Israel and your King
verses.literalPt: Eu sou o SENHOR, vosso Santo, o Criador de Israel, vosso Rei.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן בַּיָּ֖ם דָּ֑רֶךְ וּבְמַ֥יִם עַזִּ֖ים נְתִיבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh han·nō·w·ṯên bay·yām dā·reḵ ū·ḇə·ma·yim ‘az·zîm nə·ṯî·ḇāh
verses.literal: Thus says the LORD who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o SENHOR, o que preparou no mar um caminho, e nas águas impetuosas uma vereda;

verses.original: הַמּוֹצִ֥יא רֶֽכֶב־ וָס֖וּס חַ֣יִל וְעִזּ֑וּז יַחְדָּ֤ו יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ בַּל־ יָק֔וּמוּ דָּעֲכ֖וּ כַּפִּשְׁתָּ֥ה כָבֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mō·w·ṣî re·ḵeḇ- wā·sūs ḥa·yil wə·‘iz·zūz yaḥ·dāw yiš·kə·ḇū bal- yā·qū·mū dā·‘ă·ḵū kap·piš·tāh ḵā·ḇū
verses.literal: who brings out the chariots and horses the armies and warriors together to lie down never to rise again to be extinguished snuffed out like a wick
verses.literalPt: O que fez sair o carro e o cavalo, o exército e a força; eles juntamente se deitaram, e nunca se levantarão; estão extintos; como um pavio se apagaram.

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּזְכְּר֖וּ רִֽאשֹׁנ֑וֹת וְקַדְמֹנִיּ֖וֹת אַל־ תִּתְבֹּנָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiz·kə·rū ri·šō·nō·wṯ wə·qaḏ·mō·nî·yō·wṯ ’al- tiṯ·bō·nā·nū
verses.literal: Do not call to mind the former things pay no attention to the things of old
verses.literalPt: Não vos lembreis das coisas passadas, nem considereis as antigas.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י עֹשֶׂ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ עַתָּ֣ה תִצְמָ֔ח הֲל֖וֹא תֵֽדָע֑וּהָ אַ֣ף אָשִׂ֤ים בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ דֶּ֔רֶךְ בִּֽישִׁמ֖וֹן נְהָרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî ‘ō·śeh ḥă·ḏā·šāh ‘at·tāh ṯiṣ·māḥ hă·lō·w ṯê·ḏā·‘ū·hā ’ap̄ ’ā·śîm bam·miḏ·bār de·reḵ bî·ši·mō·wn nə·hā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Behold I am about to do something new even now it is coming Do you not see it Indeed I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert
verses.literalPt: Eis que faço uma coisa nova, agora sairá à luz; porventura não a percebeis? Eis que porei um caminho no deserto, e rios no ermo.

verses.original: תְּכַבְּדֵ֙נִי֙ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה תַּנִּ֖ים וּבְנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֑ה כִּֽי־ נָתַ֨תִּי בַמִּדְבָּ֜ר מַ֗יִם נְהָרוֹת֙ בִּֽישִׁימֹ֔ן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת עַמִּ֥י בְחִירִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: tə·ḵab·bə·ḏê·nî ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh tan·nîm ū·ḇə·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh kî- nā·ṯat·tî ḇam·miḏ·bār ma·yim nə·hā·rō·wṯ bî·šî·mōn lə·haš·qō·wṯ ‘am·mî ḇə·ḥî·rî
verses.literal: The beasts of the field will honor Me the jackals and the ostriches because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert to give drink to My chosen people
verses.literalPt: Os animais do campo me honrarão, os chacais, e os avestruzes; porque porei águas no deserto, e rios no ermo, para dar de beber ao meu povo, ao meu eleito.

verses.original: עַם־ זוּ֙ יָצַ֣רְתִּי לִ֔י תְּהִלָּתִ֖י יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘am- zū yā·ṣar·tî lî tə·hil·lā·ṯî yə·sap·pê·rū
verses.literal: The people . . . I formed for Myself will declare My praise
verses.literalPt: A esse povo que formei para mim; o meu louvor relatarão.

verses.original: וְלֹא־ אֹתִ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי־ יָגַ֥עְתָּ בִּ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’ō·ṯî qā·rā·ṯā ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî- yā·ḡa‘·tā bî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But you have not called on Me O Jacob because you have grown weary of Me O Israel
verses.literalPt: Contudo tu não me invocaste a mim, ó Jacó, mas te cansaste de mim, ó Israel.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ הֵבֵ֤יאתָ לִּי֙ שֵׂ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֔יךָ וּזְבָחֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א כִבַּדְתָּ֑נִי לֹ֤א הֶעֱבַדְתִּ֙יךָ֙ בְּמִנְחָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הוֹגַעְתִּ֖יךָ בִּלְבוֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō- hê·ḇê·ṯā lî śêh ‘ō·lō·ṯe·ḵā ū·zə·ḇā·ḥe·ḵā lō ḵib·baḏ·tā·nî lō he·‘ĕ·ḇaḏ·tî·ḵā bə·min·ḥāh wə·lō hō·w·ḡa‘·tî·ḵā bil·ḇō·w·nāh
verses.literal: You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings nor honored Me . . . with your sacrifices I have not burdened you with offerings nor wearied you with frankincense
verses.literalPt: Não me trouxeste o gado miúdo dos teus holocaustos, nem me honraste com os teus sacrifícios; não te fiz servir com ofertas, nem te fatiguei com incenso.

verses.original: לֹא־ קָנִ֨יתָ לִּ֤י בַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ קָנֶ֔ה וְחֵ֥לֶב זְבָחֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א הִרְוִיתָ֑נִי אַ֗ךְ הֶעֱבַדְתַּ֙נִי֙ בְּחַטֹּאותֶ֔יךָ הוֹגַעְתַּ֖נִי בַּעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- qā·nî·ṯā lî ḇak·ke·sep̄ qā·neh wə·ḥê·leḇ zə·ḇā·ḥe·ḵā lō hir·wî·ṯā·nî ’aḵ he·‘ĕ·ḇaḏ·ta·nî bə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯe·ḵā hō·w·ḡa‘·ta·nî ba·‘ă·wō·nō·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: You have not bought . . . Me sweet cane with your silver nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices But you have burdened Me with your sins you have wearied Me with your iniquities
verses.literalPt: Não me compraste por dinheiro cana aromática, nem com a gordura dos teus sacrifícios me satisfizeste, mas me deste trabalho com os teus pecados, e me cansaste com as tuas iniqüidades.

verses.original: אָנֹכִ֨י אָנֹכִ֥י ה֛וּא מֹחֶ֥ה פְשָׁעֶ֖יךָ לְמַעֲנִ֑י וְחַטֹּאתֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א אֶזְכֹּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ā·nō·ḵî hū mō·ḥeh p̄ə·šā·‘e·ḵā lə·ma·‘ă·nî wə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·ṯe·ḵā lō ’ez·kōr
verses.literal: I yes I am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more
verses.literalPt: Eu, eu mesmo, sou o que apago as tuas transgressões por amor de mim, e dos teus pecados não me lembro.

verses.original: הַזְכִּירֵ֕נִי נִשָּׁפְטָ֖ה יָ֑חַד סַפֵּ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה לְמַ֥עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: haz·kî·rê·nî niš·šā·p̄ə·ṭāh yā·ḥaḏ sap·pêr ’at·tāh lə·ma·‘an tiṣ·dāq
verses.literal: Remind Me let us argue the matter together State your case so that you may be vindicated
verses.literalPt: Faze-me lembrar; entremos juntos em juízo; conta tu as tuas razões, para que te possas justificar.

verses.original: אָבִ֥יךָ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן חָטָ֑א וּמְלִיצֶ֖יךָ פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇî·ḵā hā·ri·šō·wn ḥā·ṭā ū·mə·lî·ṣe·ḵā pā·šə·‘ū ḇî
verses.literal: Your first father sinned and your spokesmen rebelled against Me
verses.literalPt: Teu primeiro pai pecou, e os teus intérpretes prevaricaram contra mim.

verses.original: וַאֲחַלֵּ֖ל שָׂ֣רֵי קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לַחֵ֙רֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְגִדּוּפִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥal·lêl śā·rê qō·ḏeš wə·’et·tə·nāh la·ḥê·rem ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḡid·dū·p̄îm
verses.literal: So I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary and I will devote Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach
verses.literalPt: Por isso profanei os príncipes do santuário; e entreguei Jacó ao anátema, e Israel ao opróbrio.
